description: This file contains controller functions for managing channel states and WhatsApp login flows within a user interface project. It defines functions to load channel status, initiate WhatsApp login, wait for login completion, and log out, handling asynchronous requests and updating the application state accordingly.

methods.description: Initiates the WhatsApp login process, requesting a QR code and login message, updating the application state accordingly.

methods.name: export async function waitWhatsAppLogin(state: ChannelsState) { waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits for the WhatsApp login to complete, updating the state based on success or failure feedback from the client.

methods.description: Logs out from WhatsApp by requesting the client to perform the logout and updating the state to reflect the logged-out status.
